chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ismail Al Basry, from Al Fuzayl Bin Yasaar who said:

I said to Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him), 'The people are disliking the sending of blessings upon Muhammad and his Progeny in three places – during the sneezing, and during the slaughtering, and during the copulation'. So Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him) said: 'What is the matter with them? Woe be unto them! They have become hypocrites, may Allah curse them!'.
ai.seo_question: Why do people dislike sending blessings during specific acts like sneezing or slaughtering?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) addresses the specific cultural aversion to reciting Salawat during bodily functions or acts, declaring that those who avoid this practice have fallen into hypocrisy (nifaq). This hadith highlights the Shia emphasis on maintaining constant remembrance of the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt, regardless of ritual purity states, contrasting with views that restrict blessings to times of formal worship.

en.hubeali: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ismail Al Basry, from Al Fuzayl Bin Yasaar who said,

‘I said to Abu Ja’farasws, ‘The people are disliking the (sending of) Salawāt upon Muhammadsaww and hisazwj Progenyasws in three places – during the sneezing, and during the slaughtering, and during the copulation’. So Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘What is matter with them? Woe be unto them! They have become hypocrites, may Allahazwj Curse them!’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Isma’il al-Basri from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who has said the following: “Once

I said to abu Ja’far (a.s.) ‘People do not like saying, “O Allah grant al-Salat, (favors) upon Muhammad and the AM al-Bay (family of Muhammad),” in three conditions: when sneezing, when slaughtering an animal and at the time of having intimate relations with their spouses.’ Abu Ja’far (a.s.) said, ‘What is wrong with them, woe upon them! It is due to their hypocrisy, may Allah condemn them.’”
